## Hooks

> Import as `use soma_ui::use_hook_name;`

| Hook | Params | Returns |
|------|--------|---------|
| `use_clipboard` | `` | `UseClipboardReturn` |
| `use_local_storage` | `key: &'static str, default: &'static str,` | `(Signal<String>, Callback<String>)` |
| `use_locale` | `default: &'static str, rtl: &'static [&'static str],` | `(Signal<String>, Callback<String>)` |
| `use_media_query` | `query: &'static str` | `Signal<bool>` |
| `use_theme` | `` | `UseThemeReturn` |
| `use_toggle` | `initial: bool` | `(Signal<bool>, Callback<()>)` |
| `use_window_size` | `` | `(Signal<f64>, Signal<f64>)` |
